resources.string: For the Syclop maintainer: configure Syclop’s public Trakt application registration once. Viewers connect their own Trakt accounts using the normal approval code.

Create the Syclop application at developer.trakt.tv/apps/new using the owner’s verified GitHub-linked account. Enter its Client ID and exact registered HTTPS redirect URI. No client secret or user password is needed. Changing this registration requires reconnecting existing Trakt accounts.
Syclop’s Trakt connection has not been configured by the app maintainer yet. Account sign-in becomes available after application setup.
